::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 46,751 people lived in County Longford, up 14.4% on 2016. It had the second smallest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 40% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Longford was €1,120, the 19th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Longford

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Longford was €23,725, the lowest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Longford was €209,300, the lowest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 2.1 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Longford, the lowest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 33% of households in County Longford rented their home, the second highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 21% of people living in County Longford were born outside Ireland, the 5th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 38% of people aged 3 and over in County Longford said they could speak Irish, the 21st highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 26% of people at work in County Longford worked from home for at least part of the week, the 23rd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 76% of people travelling to work in County Longford went by car, the 12th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Longford live more than 4.1 km by road from a GP, the 4th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Longford live more than 37.9 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 4th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 9.8% of County Longford in 2021, the 17th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
